The main takeaway from our work is that

, in this series, the 4-substitution of the 2,4-dinitrobenzyl moiety is of little consequence to the cytotoxicity of the prodrug in the presence of nitroreductases, and that the degree of activation of the prodrug is dependent mainly on the reduction potential (and hence the electron-withdrawing ability) of the 2-substituent.

the reduction potentials of the 2-NO2 groups of the prodrugs are important in determining the extent of their activation by the NR2 enzyme and thus the potential of the compounds as prodrugs in an ADEPT strategy.
